title: Four lemma (injectivity) in an abelian category
statement:
Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] and consider a commutative diagram
$$\begin{array}{ccccccc}W&\to&X&\to&Y&\to&Z\\
\downarrow{\scriptstyle\alpha}&&\downarrow{\scriptstyle\beta}&&\downarrow{\scriptstyle\gamma}&&\downarrow{\scriptstyle\delta}\\
W'&\to&X'&\to&Y'&\to&Z'\end{array}$$
in $\mathcal A$ whose rows are exact at $X,Y$ and at $X',Y'$. If $\alpha$ is an epimorphism and $\beta$ and $\delta$ are monomorphisms, then $\gamma$ is a monomorphism.
